# Jay Group

Jay Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Jay Group offers industry-leading 3PL logistics, eCommerce fulfillment & specialty packaging services. Jay Group employs 428 people (+8.1% YoY, +32 people) and has an annual revenue of $96M, founded in 1965. Headquartered in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, United States, with offices in Reno and Houston. Its workforce is distributed across 8 countries (including United States, India, United Kingdom, Brazil, and Malaysia).

## About

Award-winning 3PL provider specializing in nationwide omnichannel fulfillment, advanced packaging, warehousing, and freight solutions. A 6-time Inc. 5000 honoree as one of the fastest-growing private companies. Four FDA-registered facilities in Lancaster and Mountville, PA, Reno, NV, and Houston, TX — 770,000 square feet with temperature-controlled storage available and ISO 27001 certified security. Operates on Manhattan Associates' WMS. Services include eCommerce fulfillment, drop shipping, Amazon prep, retail and wholesale fulfillment, advanced kitting, reverse logistics, and value-added services such as display assembly, shrink wrapping, labeling, and repackaging. Seamless integrations with 50+ platforms — powered by an in-house development team. Advanced tracking for lots, serial numbers, and expiration dates. Privately owned for over 60 years, delivering scalable, tech-driven logistics solutions across industries.

To learn more, call us toll-free at 1-888-422-7989, or visit us at www.jaygroup.com

# The Jay Group, Ltd

The Jay Group, Ltd is a Wholesale company. The Jay Group, Ltd employs 70 people (-1.4% YoY, -1 person) and has an annual revenue of $4.8M, founded in 1930. Headquartered in Rocky Mount, North Carolina, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Brazil.

## About

The Jay Group is one of the largest, privately held, wholesalers of discount footwear in the world. We purchase returns, closeouts, cancellations, factory defectives, stock-lots, liquidation, and all types of footwear from leading retailers, factories, and manufacturers on an international basis. We sell our product to international, value driven markets, around the world with distribution in over 36 countries. 

We continue to be the leading global footwear supplier of store returns and discount footwear. With over 70 years of experience in the footwear industry and one of the largest on-hand inventories in the world, The Jay Group stocks over 2 million units and distributes footwear in emerging markets in Africa, Central and South America.
